in_marathi.name: Anamitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anamitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anamitra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'anasa' meaning universe and 'mitra' meaning friend. This name signifies a friend of the universe or a friend to all. In Hindu mythology, Anamitra is the name of the divine friend of Lord Vishnu.
